parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The email address of the contact.

parameters.name: Idcard
parameters.description: The ID card number of the contact. This parameter is required for the CFCA certificate brand and is not required for other brands.

parameters.name: Mobile
parameters.description: The phone number of the contact.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the certificate contact.

parameters.name: Webhooks
parameters.description: The webhook URLs of DingTalk, WeCom, or Lark chatbots. The value is a string in list format.
